Class MethodInventoryTracker

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.collection.MethodInventoryTracker
public class MethodInventoryTracker extends Object
Tracks declared method signatures for each class in a package directory and publishes telemetry when method additions or removals are detected.

  • Method Details

    • observe

      public void observe(String packageDirectory, String className, Set<String> currentMethods)
      Compares a class's current method signatures with its previously stored inventory. The first observation establishes a baseline without publishing method-change events.
      Parameters:
      packageDirectory - the absolute package-directory key
      className - the class whose methods are being observed
      currentMethods - the class's current method signatures

    • forgetClass

      public void forgetClass(String packageDirectory, String className)
      Removes stored method inventory for one class. The next observation of the class establishes a fresh baseline.
      Parameters:
      packageDirectory - the class package directory
      className - the class to forget

    • forgetPackage

      public void forgetPackage(String packageDirectory)
      Removes stored method inventory for every class in a package directory.
      Parameters:
      packageDirectory - the package directory to forget

    • retainClasses

      public void retainClasses(String packageDirectory, Set<String> currentClassNames)
      Removes stored method inventory for classes no longer present in a package. Stored inventory for the remaining classes is preserved.
      Parameters:
      packageDirectory - the package directory being retained
      currentClassNames - the class names currently present in the package
